name: preflight
description: Pega na escrita o que o /code-review pegaria depois: bloqueia edição de arquivo via Bash dentro de qualquer repositório git, roda o pre-commit do repo a cada Edit/Write e no fim do turno, aponta sobras de identificadores removidos e injeta no system prompt os findings recorrentes do projeto.

allowBashWrites.title: Allow Bash file writes
allowBashWrites.description: Disable the guard that denies writing repo files through Bash (sed -i, heredocs, redirects).

precommitTimeoutMs.title: pre-commit timeout (ms)
precommitTimeoutMs.description: How long one pre-commit run may take before it is abandoned.
